# FG-GIT-0011

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 400 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_hex_like_ref_name_is_ambiguous` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: オブジェクト ID と区別できない名前のブランチ・タグは作れません。
- en: A branch or tag name that looks like an object ID is not allowed.
- id: Nama branch atau tag yang terlihat seperti ID objek tidak diizinkan.

## 原因 (cause)

A push named a ref whose branch or tag name (for other refs: the name after refs/) is 40 or 64 hexadecimal digits. git resolves such a name as an object id before it looks at refs, so `git checkout <name>` or a merge request against it would silently use a commit instead of the ref.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason=object_id_like` and `len` (40 or 64); the push was refused as a whole before git ran (the refusal is in-band: `ng <ref> FG-GIT-0011 ...`, see `denied_refs`).

## 対処 (fix)

Rename the branch or tag (e.g. add a prefix such as `fix-`) and push again.
